Every requirement maps to planned work below. **Nothing is marked complete.** References are to [brief.md](/private/tmp/cc-cpm-w4-t536/onboarding-eval-rqclHS/project/brief.md) unless stated otherwise.

| Source | Requirement | Tickets | Acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Background | 40 plots; March–October seasons | P04, P08 | Valid season records; coordinator grid contains all 40 plots |
| Users | Gardeners and coordinator have distinct access | P04, P05 | Role and cross-household access tests |
| First version 1 | Apply for the coming season with up to three preferred plots | P06 | Mobile submission; valid distinct preferences; duplicate submission handled safely |
| First version 2 | Coordinator allocates plots and moves unallocated applicants to the waiting list | P07 | Application-to-allocation demonstration; unallocated applicants retain application order |
| First version 3 | Gardener sees allocated plot and season dates | P08 | Signed-in household sees its correct allocation and dates |
| First version 4 | Gardener reports a problem with their plot | P10 | Own-plot authorization, durable submission and confirmation |
| First version 4 | Coordinator sees open problems and resolves them | P11 | Open report becomes resolved without losing history |
| First version 5 | Coordinator sees a grid of plots and holders | P08 | Correct occupied/empty states; accessible list alternative |
| Rules | At most one plot per household per season | P04, P07 | Database constraints and concurrent-allocation tests |
| Rules | Returning gardeners applying before 1 February receive priority | P04, P06, P07 | Historical holdings determine eligibility; cutoff and ordering tests |
| Rules | Waiting list is strictly first come, first served | P07 | Stable application ordering; promotion, assignment and reassignment cannot bypass the queue |
| Constraints | Works on phones | P02, P06, P08, P10, P15 | Phone journey walkthroughs and integrated tests |
| Constraints | Contact details visible only to coordinator | P04, P05, P08, P14, P15 | Server authorization tests and privacy checks across screens, APIs and logs |
| Constraints | Large text and plain language | P02, P03, P15 | Prototype review, zoom/keyboard checks and accessibility walkthrough |
| Your sign-in decision | Emailed one-time links; no passwords | P01, P05 | Email feasibility; single-use, expiry, resend and access tests |
| Your notification decision | One daily email listing new problem reports | P01, P12 | Sample digest; scheduling, batching, failure and retry tests |
| Later scope | Online payments | Explicitly deferred | No first-version implementation ticket |
| Later scope | Tool lending | Explicitly deferred | No first-version implementation ticket |

These additional choices are **proposed assumptions**, not requirements attributed to the brief:

| Assumption or implementation responsibility | Where captured |
|---|---|
| Coordinator-managed households, one sign-in email per household, validated previous-season holdings | P03–P05 |
| Initial allocation opens on 1 February to protect returning-applicant priority | P02, P03, P07, P15 |
| Zero preferences permitted; preferences do not guarantee a particular plot | P03, P06, P07 |
| One household per plot per season; retries cannot create duplicate allocations | P04, P07 |
| No empty daily email; newly reported but already resolved problems remain included | P12, P13 |
| Durable email delivery tracking and recovery | P01, P12, P14 |
| Technology selection delegated to implementation | P01 |
| Actual timezone, season dates, digest time and hosting configuration established before launch | P04, P12, P14, P16 |
| Retention arrangements, backup recovery and coordinator operating instructions | P14, P16 |
| Deployment requires launch authorization | P17 |
